knowledge/flink-statefun-architecture-lo.author: adrianb
knowledge/flink-statefun-architecture-lo.contentPreview:
## Executive Summary

## Executive summary

Apache Flink Stateful Functions (StateFun) v3.2.0 rethinks stateful stream processing: it **logically co-locates** state and compute (so it keeps Flink's exactly-once consistency) but lets you **physically separate** them (so functions scale/deploy independently like stateless services). The Flink runtime owns state + messaging + invocation routing; functions are just invoked with message+state bundled in the request.

knowledge/flink-statefun-building-blocks.title: Flink StateFun building blocks — ingress, functions, state, egress
knowledge/flink-statefun-building-blocks.author: adrianb
knowledge/flink-statefun-building-blocks.contentPreview:
## Executive Summary

## Executive summary

A StateFun application is an event-driven loop: **ingress** → **stateful functions** (with **persisted state**, messaging each other arbitrarily, not a static DAG) → **egress**. Exactly-once holds for *both* state and messages: on failure the whole world (state + in-flight messages) rolls back to simulate failure-free execution, via Flink's snapshotting — **no database required**.

knowledge/flink-statefun-logical-functio.title: Flink StateFun logical functions — addressing & lifecycle
knowledge/flink-statefun-logical-functio.author: adrianb
knowledge/flink-statefun-logical-functio.contentPreview:
## Executive Summary

## Executive summary

StateFun functions are **logical/virtual**: unbounded instances on finite resources. An instance uses no CPU/threads/memory when not invoked and has no state. Model applications as granularly as makes sense — don't design around resource limits. An **Address = FunctionType + ID** (type ≈ class, ID ≈ primary key); all reads/writes during an invocation are scoped to that address. **Single writer per key** at a time. Instances are never created/destroyed

knowledge/flink-statefun-modules-module-.author: adrianb
knowledge/flink-statefun-modules-module-.contentPreview:
## Executive Summary

## Executive summary

A StateFun **application module** is a YAML file describing the components of an app: function endpoints, ingress, and egress definitions. The file is **multi-document YAML** (`---`-separated); each document is one component = a `kind` typename + a `spec` object. Modules are attached to the runtime container (mounted as a ConfigMap in k8s).
